   - Navigate to the CloudWatch dashboard.
   - Click on "Alarms" in the left-hand menu.

   - Select "FreeStorageSpace" as the metric name.
   - Select "db-primary" as the DB instance identifier.

   - Set the comparison operator to "Less than threshold".
   - Set the evaluation period to 1 period.
   - Set the period to 5 minutes.
   - Set the statistic to "Average".
